title: Direct-Shear Safety Check of Basketball-Hoop Mounting Bolts During a Dunk
summary: Evaluate four basketball-hoop mounting bolts for average direct shear, factor of safety against shear yielding, and minimum required bolt diameter.
idealizedImageAlt: Instructor reference diagram of a four-bolt connection sharing vertical shear and a representative bolt in single shear.
problemStatement:
A design team is reviewing the four bolts that connect a basketball backboard mounting plate to its horizontal support arm. A short-duration dunk load is represented by an equivalent static downward connection shear V = {{bolt_V}} {{bolt_V_unit}}. The {{bolt_n_b}} identical bolts are assumed to share that direct shear equally, with {{bolt_n_s}} shear plane per bolt through the smooth shank.

This introductory connector check intentionally excludes eccentric bolt-group moment, bolt tension, bearing, tear-out, prying, thread-root reduction, preload and friction, fatigue, and local plate deformation.
engineeringGoal: Determine the average bolt shear stress, shear-yield factor of safety, minimum nominal bolt diameter, and allowable group load. Decide whether the proposed {{bolt_d}} {{bolt_d_unit}} bolts satisfy the required factor of safety {{bolt_FS_req}} within the stated direct-shear model.
